detail: Newell suffered the toe injury in the Nov. 4 win over Washington and is now set to miss an extended period. With Mouhamed Gueye (foot) expected to miss at least three more weeks, Aaron Wiggins and Corey Kispert could see a slight bump in minutes moving forward.

Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.

With Robinson set to miss a third contest due to an illness, Boston will again be without one of its primary center options. His absence should continue to leave more frontcourt minutes available for Neemias Queta and Luka Garza on Tuesday, with the former being in line to see the lion's share of the playing time.
Allen is set to miss a third consecutive contest due to a concussion. Sion James will continue to start while Royce O'Neale should get more minutes off the bench.
Williams will miss a second consecutive game due to right hamstring injury management. Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun should continue to see more minutes off the bench for Charlotte.

The rookie forward went down during Wednesday's loss to the Spurs, and he now needs surgery to repair a fractured right hand. More pressure will likely fall on Josh Giddey going forward, while the likes of Tre Jones and Isaac Okoro will have a chance for added streaming value.

Tyson has missed the last three games due to right ankle injury management. An upgrade to probable is a good sign, but we'll need to get confirmation from Cleveland prior to tipoff in Chicago. If he does indeed suit up, Tyrese Proctor, Mario Hezonja and Meleek Thomas could all see their minutes dip.

Tomlin, who is recovering from a lower back stress reaction, has yet to suit up for the Cavs this season. He continues to get ruled out 24 hours in advance of tipoff, indicating he's still not close, so he can be viewed as week-to-week moving forward.
Lawal is slated for a fourth consecutive absence due to a right groin strain. His next opportunity to return will arrive Friday in Phoenix.

Washington is trying to end a two-game absence Tuesday with an illness. Following consecutive starts, Zaccharie Risacher figures to have the most to gain from another potential absence for Washington from a fantasy perspective.

The superstar point guard has been managing lingering knee soreness as of late, but he's expected to fight through the issue Tuesday. Since the start of November,  Cunningham has averaged 25.6 points, 9.1 assists, 4.8 rebounds and 1.6 steals per contest covering nine appearances.

Curry suffered the injury early during Wednesday's loss to the Rockets, with head coach Steve Kerr saying after the game that the superstar point guard "tweaked" something in his abdominal area. Curry has never dealt with an injury of this nature, so the Warriors, who are off to a hot start spearheaded by Rookie of the Year candidate Yaxel Lendeborg, will likely proceed with caution. Brandin Podziemski, Brandon Williams (hamstring), De'Anthony Melton, Will Richard and Gary Payton (knee) are all candidates for increased roles until Curry is cleared to play again.

Porzingis said he was looking forward to joining the Warriors, but his body didn't respond the way he wanted it too during his ramp-up process before the season. Additionally, he said he will work with the Warriors on a solution that "makes sense." Porzingis is making this decision to prioritize his health and will hopefully turn a corner soon on that front.

The veteran floor general is missing both ends of this back-to-back set, but he'll have some extra time to heal up ahead of Friday's tilt against the 76ers. Quenton Jackson should play a significant role off the bench in McConnell's absence Monday.

The swingman is sitting out the second leg of this back-to-back set and is likely facing a short-term absence. Nesmith's absence should get Obi Toppin onto the streaming map in fantasy leagues Monday.

Sheppard required a full repair and is without a definitive timetable for a return to action. With Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) expected to miss at least two weeks, Quenton Jackson figures to see a significant uptick in playing time. Two-way player Braden Smith could also see increased action with the parent club.

Antetokounmpo is dealing with a groin injury. He was initially listed as questionable, though he has since been ruled out, marking his first absence of the year. His next opportunity to suit up will come Wednesday against Philadelphia. In the meantime, Bobby Portis and Andrew Wiggins are candidates to fill the void in the starting lineup.

This was the expectation after the star guard requested a trade from the Pelicans earlier Friday. Given his standing with the club, Murray can be tentatively considered doubtful for future contests while New Orleans tries to find him another home.
McBride will miss his first outing of the 2026-27 campaign due to left adductor tightness. Tyler Kolek and Jose Alvarado should absorb the majority of the vacated minutes off the Knicks' bench.

Once Sorber begins on-court work, there will be a ramp-up period before he's cleared for game-time action, so his absence will likely extend well beyond this initial 6-8-week window. Sorber was selected by the Thunder with the No. 15 pick in the 2025 NBA Draft, but he missed his entire rookie season after tearing the ACL in his right knee and has yet to play this season due to right knee issues.

This is another massive blow to an Oklahoma City squad that's already set to be without Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) for most, if not all, of the season. With Holmgren sidelined, Kenrich Williams, Jaylin Williams and Aday Mara are all candidates to see increased playing time. Two-way player Brooks Barnhizer could also see more minutes.

The star big man can be considered day-to-day moving forward. With Embiid sidelined Monday, Dominick Barlow is a candidate to start at center for the 76ers while Adem Bona (back) helps pick up the slack off the bench.

Krejci suffered the ankle injury in last Wednesday's win over the Suns and is set to miss an extended period after undergoing surgery. With the 26-year-old and Ja Morant (hamstring) both on the shelf, Jrue Holiday and Sidy Cissoko should continue seeing increased minutes.

Wembanyama is dealing with lower-back tightness, leaving his status for Monday's road tilt up in the air. If he's unable to play, Luke Kornet would likely replace Wembanyama in the starting lineup, while Carter Bryant, Keldon Johnson and rookie Tarris Reed Jr. could all see a bump in minutes off the Spurs' bench.

Beekman is set for an extended absence, with his re-evaluation timeline suggesting he could remain sidelined beyond the initial three-week window. The injury further limits Washington's backcourt depth, though Beekman's absence is unlikely to have a significant impact on standard fantasy leagues.
